title: Austin Approves $10K for Power Infrastructure
summary:
• **Electrical Infrastructure Investment**: The council approved a $10,000 appropriation to purchase poles, wire, transformers, and related materials for the city's electrical system.

• **Bond Interest Payment**: Council authorized spending $30,030 to cover interest payments due July 1st on the city's $1.505 million in refunding bonds.

• **Councilmen on Leave**: Two council members were granted one-month absences—Bartholomew from mid-June and Powell from late June through July.
